text:
[IARC.3.11.2] **On a microcontroller build the board supplies the live
clocks.** `ds_platform_now_ns` is required and is the monotonic source.
`ds_platform_wall_ns` is optional: a board **may** define it, and it reports
whether the wall clock has a value and, when it does, UTC nanoseconds since the
Unix epoch. The integrator implements it over whatever the board learns the time
from — an RTC, a network time source, an upstream message — and has it report no
value until then. A board that does not define it, or before it reports a
value, has a live wall clock with no value ([LTIM.2.8.3]).

The shim is the only way to give a live wall clock its value. The mock setter is
not ([NLFC.5.3]).
